name: NSF Postdoctoral Research Fellowships in Biology (PRFB)
amount: USD 220,000 over 24 months (USD 85,000/year stipend + USD 25,000/year research and training allowance)
other_rules: US citizens, nationals or permanent residents at submission
no more than 15 months in positions requiring a doctorate before the deadline
two lifetime submissions, one per year
sponsor must broaden the applicant's research
2026 solicitation focuses on AI and biology for biotechnology
notes: Deadlines: 29 Sep 2026, 28 Sep 2027, then the fourth Tuesday of September. About 75 awards. Candidate submits via Research.gov.

documents.name: Project summary
documents.notes: Separate intellectual merit and broader impacts statements

documents.name: Project description
documents.notes: Sections titled Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts; includes figures

documents.name: Reference letters
documents.notes: Up to two, each max 3 pages, submitted by referees
